### Key Facts on Alcohol Metabolism

- **The liver does most of the work:** Most alcohol is broken down by liver enzymes, while a small amount (about 5% to 10%) leaves through breath, sweat, and urine.
- **The rate is steady:** Drinking more, exercising, drinking coffee, or taking a cold shower will not speed up how fast your liver clears alcohol.
- **Individual factors matter:** Body weight, biological sex, age, liver health, and certain medications can influence how alcohol affects you and how quickly it is processed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX6Lln-WiDBE_sSkTA3_GFMk-PKUsDHkdTkxt0BSkLI4TBEwDf0E1HGTzEEGpYAd_wt9tsRjzIuTSNJU8VKiDCdY4aqQW4u_I7u39iRiNyFRkzg5WCZcPBo3RVxY7IS6rAbmvDhosK4MCSiS1Uo0CMXMzAyc2jb3E5nh4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF12moZDG1G97G6S-Lzsfsw18bhAgrNsPW8p1Uu09J8ANuaVagtiBMRHZfwHJnizW01s2G80SxuGCBksoVj_Elu6SfBAlbYJGMyPGik7vyQbXaNiLQUPrwmQf4yZw2YfD2PzZ8FcnfzHoV--f7lYPFecMBl2xgdAJb5fxZc8J6VFkEROViuWbvApcw4Rj6bd61SmsleRbkeMmv)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX71Andaorlepwyh5gFODJMrgpL-0xYrTieAvGIaBu5_TY7WO29562O8RC_nEW4bjqXRwtJLZMq7tr57SPqlBUAw4oHFwPCSU7ki2iJy9MgpBuo1LG8fSkLQhKVBK_JFDfm9Cmb2FLG2AWGGXxKoZ63RjtWA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF18A3Njd4gymLTR9C4Qvj2y5fvd2LgL3KYESMhR3EdZtZpRggJBY33WX8MPItiBXpwSljLr1J8CNuWWq_5r3R5ECmmNnJ73dMIbnKuFvfu_BTiPWermasFeQGJF6h9pHRjF_n121C63cm0fi1tp4GKqfTkFrEufCxBlss6KtxohT-xjJv)
